verdict.rationale: Docusaurus installs locally via `npx create-docusaurus` and builds to plain static files in a `build` directory, which can be served with `docusaurus serve` or deployed to any static host, so self-hosting is the core model. Community posts independently confirm it is open source and MIT licensed, and one user describes running it on their own VM. Missing for 10: first-party guidance on serving the build from your own web server (e.g. nginx) rather than the listed third-party hosting services.
